rolls-royce-ghost.author: Oleg Yunakov
rolls-royce-ghost.alt: Rolls-Royce Ghost Series II (2025) in a light bronze-taupe, front three-quarter view
rolls-royce-ghost.note: Second-generation Ghost Series II (2024 facelift), the version now sold in India: L-shaped DRL running over and down the headlamp, and twin chrome blades in the lower intake (checked on a crop). New York auto show 2025; the Rolls-Royce/Bentley stand is in the background.

rolls-royce-ghost.author: Charles from Port Chester, New York
rolls-royce-ghost.alt: Rolls-Royce Ghost Series II dashboard with wood veneer, glass fascia panel and white leather
rolls-royce-ghost.note: Second-generation Ghost Series II cabin (uploader: 2025 Ghost II): the clock sits in the glass panel that runs across to the passenger side, with GHOST lettering.

rolls-royce-cullinan.author: Oleg Yunakov
rolls-royce-cullinan.alt: Rolls-Royce Cullinan Series II in white, front three-quarter view
rolls-royce-cullinan.note: Cullinan Series II (2024 facelift), as sold in India: vertical DRL strips running down from the headlamps and the new lower bumper. New York auto show 2025.

rolls-royce-cullinan.author: Alexander Migl
rolls-royce-cullinan.alt: Rolls-Royce Cullinan Series II in pale blue-green, rear three-quarter view
rolls-royce-cullinan.note: Cullinan Series II displayed at BMW Welt, Munich (same car shown front-on in the set has the Series II vertical DRLs). Clean showroom background.

rolls-royce-phantom.author: Oleg Yunakov
rolls-royce-phantom.alt: Rolls-Royce Phantom Extended Series II in a dark green-black, front three-quarter view
rolls-royce-phantom.note: Phantom VIII Series II (2022 facelift): illuminated Pantheon grille, current wheel design. Extended-wheelbase body, which India sells as Phantom Extended Series II.

rolls-royce-phantom.file: File:Rolls-Royce Phantom VIII Series II Scivaro Grey Peony Pink Iceland Moss (1).jpg
rolls-royce-phantom.author: Damian B Oh
rolls-royce-phantom.alt: Rolls-Royce Phantom Series II dashboard with the glass Gallery panel, grey leather and bespoke pink accents
rolls-royce-phantom.note: Phantom Series II launch car in Korea: Gallery dashboard and current steering wheel. The pink accents are a bespoke colour choice.

rolls-royce-spectre.note: Spectre electric coupé (2023 on, the only generation): split headlamps and widest-ever Pantheon grille. UK car on a dealer display plate; identical to Indian cars.

rolls-royce-spectre.note: Same Spectre: fastback roof and slim vertical tail lamps.
